zh.title: 审批记录存了动作，放行时是否真的比较？
zh.summary: 固定源码的隔离实验中，改变请求编号、目标或参数仍得到审批阶段放行。结果只定位了本阶段的载荷绑定边界；调用方、恢复令牌、其他策略与最终效果仍需分别核验。

en.title: An approval record stores the action. Does acceptance compare it?
en.summary: An isolated pinned-source probe accepts changes to request ID, target or parameters at the approval stage. This locates a local binding boundary; callers, resume tokens, other policy stages and final effects remain separate verification objects.
